candidate_followup: Only the solver.unsat module docstring and benchmark artifacts differ; executable production logic is unchanged.
warmup: One complete shuffled pass before each measured pass in every process.
ordering: Alternate process launch order by pair; identical workload shuffle seed inside each pair.
sampling: All measured samples retained. GC enabled. Interpreter startup and imports excluded from API timing.
limits: Shared Linux host, not an isolated performance lab. Only agent-owned test/build processes are awaited; other workloads are not controlled. Wall and process CPU times plus load averages are retained.
pilot_adjustments: An initial full pilot with captured progress was interrupted and produced no complete sample.

A 16-way modulo-guard baseline was interrupted during compile_bmc_query, in guarded definedness construction; it is outside the 30s solve budget. The scaling case uses 16 equality guards in the measured matrix.
The existing VTOL invariant bound was reduced from 10 to 4 before measurement, after the baseline pilot took about 38.8 seconds under concurrent checks.
The initial pilot matrix was expanded to all seven property kinds, a short-name control and two original measurement cases before being frozen.
Exploratory pilots overlapped local verification, and their times are not used in the measured comparison.
comparison_note: Solver call counts and selected core identities may vary even when semantic observations agree. Both are reported; differences are not silently counted as exact compatibility.
